templates.title: Orcaslicer
templates.name: orcaslicer
templates.description: Orca Slicer is an open source slicer for FDM printers. OrcaSlicer is fork of Bambu Studio, it was previously known as BambuStudio-SoftFever, Bambu Studio is forked from PrusaSlicer by Prusa Research, which is from Slic3r by Alessandro Ranellucci and the RepRap community
templates.note: An open source slicer for FDM printers. OrcaSlicer is fork of Bambu Studio, it was previously known as BambuStudio-SoftFever, Bambu Studio is forked from PrusaSlicer by Prusa Research, which is from Slic3r by Alessandro Ranellucci and the RepRap community
